connector.name: DevSpeak
connector.registryDescription: Official DevSpeak MCP server - translate technical text into formal specs from any AI IDE or agent
connector.summary: Hosted at devspeak.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the juanjaragavi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DEVSPEAK_API_KEY
env.description: DevSpeak API key. Generate one from Settings → API Keys in the DevSpeak dashboard.

env.name: DEVSPEAK_API_URL
env.description: Optional DevSpeak API base URL override. Leave unset to use https://www.devspeak.dev.
